component.name: RenPyDeck
component.summary: Game manager and launcher for Ren'Py games on the Steam Deck

description.p: RenPyDeck keeps your collection of downloaded Ren'Py games in one place and turns the download, install, play and uninstall lifecycle into a few taps in a clean graphical interface. It is designed first and foremost for the Steam Deck.

Downloaded archives and installed games appear in a single library. Select a game and its buttons appear on that row: install it, launch it, or remove it. RenPyDeck handles the fiddly parts — unpacking the archive into a subfolder of its own and setting the executable bits Linux needs — so a game is ready to play as soon as it is installed.

ul.li: Installs from .zip, .rar, .7z and the .tar family of archives
Keeps the archive after installing, so a game can be reinstalled without downloading it again — or deletes it to reclaim the space, if you prefer
Removes an installed game, its archive, or both, after asking which
Lists only games it can actually start: support is decided by what is inside the archive, not by its filename, so Windows-only releases stay out of the way
Download and games folders are yours to choose

description.p: Everything is built for the Deck's gaming mode, where windows have no decorations and dialogs may never appear: RenPyDeck lives in one window with an on-screen Exit button, asks its questions on pages inside it, scrolls by finger, and is dark whether or not the desktop says so.
The library, and the install, launch and remove actions on it, with the download and games folders configurable from the app.
